choices.text: Answer in person

ok.log: You answer in person. {He} has become everything you hoped, which is the difficulty. It takes all you have, and at the end you hold {gyb_piece}, and there is no one left to correct.

fail.log: You answer in person. {He} has become everything you hoped, and you are not what you were. You wake in a bed that is not yours, in a town you do not know. Someone has paid the bill in advance.

choices.text: Answer on paper, and correct {his} grammar

effects.log: You send it back with the second line marked. It is petty. It is also the only thing you have done that truly enraged {him}, and it keeps you warm a while.
